title: Apex Drift
tagline: Drift to charge boost, slipstream five rivals and win the cup across a sunset coast, a neon city and a snowbound alpine pass.
description: An arcade racer built for flow. Hold drift through a corner to slide at an angle and charge your boost meter. Sparks change from blue to orange to purple as the drift goes on, and letting go fires a slingshot boost. Spend the meter on the straights, tuck in behind a rival to slipstream, and nail the lights for a rocket start. Race five rivals with their own lines and personalities. Their catch-up is subtle and fades out before the finish, so the last lap is decided by how you drive. There are three tracks: Amber Coast, a cliff road above a golden sea; Lumen City, neon downtown with an elevated sweeper; and Frostpeak Pass, alpine switchbacks in falling snow. Modes: a 3-race Grand Prix with points and grids reversed by the standings, Single Race, and Time Trial against a ghost of your best lap with Bronze/Silver/Gold/Apex medals. A podium finish in the Sunset Cup unlocks the Mirror Cup, which runs every track in reverse.
controls: Keyboard: W/↑ gas · S/↓ brake/reverse · A/D or ←/→ steer · Space drift · Shift boost · R reset to track · C camera · B look back · Esc/P pause. Gamepad: RT/LT gas/brake · stick steer · A/RB drift · X/LB boost · Y reset · Back camera · Start pause. Touch: analog steering pad + GAS/BRAKE/DRIFT/BOOST pedals, optional auto-accelerate and tilt steering.
fablePass: Music: per-track driving loops (coastal synthwave, neon city drum & bass, alpine orchestral-electronic) with an intensity layer on the final lap
Start: driver intro on the grid and a gantry light-board animation; podium: drivers climbing out, trophy lift, champagne
Cars: suspension bounce on landing/kerbs, door-mirror and wing flex, wheel blur at speed, damage scuffs on hard wall hits
World: gulls and sailboats on Amber Coast, traffic-light and billboard animation in Lumen City, snow plough and chairlift on Frostpeak Pass
Crowd and marshal flag waves at the start/finish; finish-line photo-flash
